verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an analytics platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Amplitude: it describes hosted APIs, SDKs, data export and warehouse integrations. Local flag evaluation in the SDKs is an adjacent feature and does not amount to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
